## Summary

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link the task/specification ID.

## Evidence

- [ ] `bun run verify:release` passed; include relevant verification feature paths.
- [ ] Real user path and side effects exercised; attach sanitized evidence.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or private access links in changes/history/artifacts.
- [ ] Work log records Asia/Damascus date, reason, verification and limitations.

## Merge danger

State behavioral/security risks, provider checks still needed and rollback steps.
One coherent change; target `nightly` for candidates or `main` for verified stable promotion.
